Traffic now leaves through the proxy."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Settings persist in DSH `settings.yaml` under `dsh-proxy:` and apply live."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Piece | Requirement |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| DSH | `0.1.2-rc.1` and later hosts that still expose `ctx.settings.register` and `settings.section"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"` |

| Market | `dsh.bundle.patch`, bilingual README, prebuilt"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" client factory, no `prepare` script |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The 0.3.x line replaced the old `installSettingsSection` + `settings.plugin.item` APIs that broke af"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" replaced the old `installSettingsSection` + `settings.plugin.item` APIs that broke after DSH 0.1.1."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Implementation (0.4.0)"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The host half no longer swaps global `fetch` for an undici one. It keeps **Node's native fetch** and"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" attaches an undici `dispatcher` to each request:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- Proxy-matching hosts use a `ProxyAgent`; `noProxy` hosts use an explicit `Agent` (direct).

- Unloading the plugin restores the exact original `fetch`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The client settings page registers into `settings.section` and depends on the `settingsScope`, `slot"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"s`, and `locale` services."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Desktop note"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"If a desktop profile fails to load because of one bad plugin, the app enters the **safe profile** an"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"d purges every user plugin from it at startup (`SAFE_MODE_PLUGIN_PURGE` in the log).
